verdict.rationale: Activepieces is a workflow automation platform where flows start from a trigger and run actions (docs-21, docs-39). The changelog example "summarise my unread emails every morning" producing a drafted agent implies recurring, time-based execution (docs-8). However, no evidence explicitly documents a schedule or cron trigger, or how to configure recurrence intervals. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a schedule/cron trigger and its configuration options, and independent or hands-on confirmation that recurring runs work.
